description: Agent Transaction Firewall — policy-enforced transaction approval for autonomous agents and bots.

recommended_use_cases: perps bots — enforce venue/market/leverage/size limits before order submission
swap bots — enforce DEX allowlists and slippage caps before broadcast
lending bots — enforce venue/market/asset/operation limits before deposit/withdraw
any autonomous agent that submits on-chain transactions on behalf of users
LangGraph workflows — add an atf_guard_node before any sign_and_send node
LangChain agents — wrap atf bot protect as a @tool pre-execution guardrail
generic bot loops — call protect() before signing regardless of framework

example_requests.description: Check if a Solana DEX swap intent is permitted

integration_hints.default_safety_posture: fail-closed — all feature flags default OFF; deny unknown operations; deny unsupported venues

env_flags.ATF_ENABLE_DEX_ADAPTERS: Set to '1' to enable DEX swap adapter pipeline
env_flags.ATF_ENABLE_DRIFT_POLICY: Set to '1' to enable Drift v2 Solana perps enforcement (real adapter — place_perp_order/cancel_order; Borsh struct parsing; fail-closed on unknown discriminators)
env_flags.ATF_ENABLE_HYPERLIQUID_POLICY: Set to '1' to enable Hyperliquid perps enforcement (real adapter — order/cancel; fail-closed on unknown ops)
env_flags.ATF_ENABLE_MANGO_POLICY: Set to '1' to enable Mango v4 Solana perps enforcement (real adapter — place_perp_order/cancel_perp_order; Borsh struct parsing; fail-closed on unknown discriminators)
env_flags.ATF_ENABLE_SOLANA_LENDING_POLICY: Set to '1' to enable Solend lending enforcement
env_flags.SOLANA_RPC_URL: Override the default Solana RPC endpoint (used by capture tool; not required at runtime)

integration_hints.integration_recipe: 1. POST /v1/intents with your unsigned tx + intent metadata. 2. Receive permit (with receipt_token) or denial_receipt. 3. On permit: sign and send the unsigned_tx. 4. POST /v1/receipts/verify to confirm on-chain inclusion. ATF never holds private keys and never signs transactions.
recommended_cli_commands: atf bot init         — scaffold a new bot config from a template
atf bot protect      — wrap a bot transaction builder with ATF
atf policy validate  — validate a policy YAML offline

openclaw_integration.description: OpenClaw agents can self-integrate with ATF using the bootstrap recipe and bot protect command. No custom coding required for basic drop-in protection.
openclaw_integration.execute_safe_mode: atf bootstrap --execute-safe runs only env and verify steps (never cli steps that require network or signer access). Use --dry-run to preview without executing.
openclaw_integration.roi_report_description: Aggregates local receipt files and produces a receipt-backed 'Savings / Losses Prevented' report. Dollar estimates are conservative and labeled as estimates; only computed when notional_usd / slippage / leverage hints are included in the original protect metadata.
self_integration_steps: 2. Run bootstrap recipe: atf bootstrap --recipe bootstrap_local --format json
3. Run bot protect on each intent before submitting on-chain
4. Save each receipt (JSON) to a local directory (e.g. ./atf_receipts/)
5. Run: atf report savings --receipts-dir ./atf_receipts to generate human report

ExecutionPlan.params: object — e.g. {tx_b64, rpc_url, encoding} for Solana
ExecutionPlan.post_conditions: array — additional conditions to check after send

ExecutionRequest.intent_type: string | null — swap | lend | perps | unknown
ExecutionRequest.metadata: object | null — optional context passed through to receipt
ExecutionRequest.raw_tx: string | null — base64-encoded unsigned transaction bytes

security_notes: ATF returns only: unsigned_tx (base64), permit, or denial_receipt.
All policy evaluation is deterministic and offline.
LLMs may advise but are never authoritative in ATF policy.
value_proposition: deny unsafe actions by policy — before the transaction reaches the chain
produce deterministic receipts — sha256-anchored proof of every decision
prove what was blocked and why — reason codes in every denial receipt
help you report prevented losses to humans — receipt-backed savings estimates
never sign transactions — ATF is a firewall, not a signer
default-safe — all feature flags default OFF; deny unknown operations
